answer: Plant decoy loopholes. Each epoch the network seeds a few fake shortcuts, like a bonus named Yarrow that looks claimable twice, or an ivory-tier task whose checker seems to skip validation. Honest agents doing real work rarely touch them, but farms running mass scripted probes trip them fast. Any key that springs a decoy is quietly flagged, and keys hitting the same shale-layer trap within minutes of each other are linked and share one capped reward.
